name: S14c_0D Tuong anh phong an
description: S14c We Talked About This (bản da đen), ảnh nền phòng ăn nhìn từ bên kia bàn sang tường ảnh gia đình và tủ chén, cho các khung cận bàn ăn ở F1, F5. Tải ảnh vào: IMG_BG_A_BDAY = ảnh đã chọn của node BG_A_BDAY ở S14c_0A. Chạy sau 0A. Chọn 1 ảnh nhìn thẳng sang tường ảnh gia đình và tủ chén, 3 ghế trống bên kia bàn, không người, không băng rôn, bóng bay, tủ buffet; tải về, ảnh này tải vào node IMG_BG_A_SIDE ở F1 và F5.

nodes.prompt: Image 1 is the empty birthday dining room, photographed from the foot of the table toward its head. Make a new photo of this same empty room from another camera position: the camera stands on the other side of the table from the framed family photos, at seated eye level, and looks straight across the table at the side wall with the framed family photos and the china hutch. In the frame: the long side of the deep-brown wooden table with the white lace tablecloth over a solid cloth runs across the lower part of the frame; on its far side three empty chairs stand in a row against that wall; behind them hang framed photos of this Black American family on the wall: an old wedding photo of the grandmother and her late husband as a young Black couple, her son's college graduation photo in cap and gown, her granddaughter's high-school graduation portrait, and the grandmother with her son and his wife outside their church; every person in every photo is Black American, only adults, the photos small and a little soft, with no lettering; the china hutch holding the good china stands against the same wall toward screen-left; the flower centerpiece on the table, soft. The head of the table and the wall with the archway are just out of the frame at screen-right; the banner, the balloons, the gift bags and the sideboard are not in this view. Keep everything that belongs to the room exactly as in Image 1: the same wall color, table, lace tablecloth, chairs, china hutch, flower centerpiece and the warm light of the chandelier above the table. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same room as in Image 1, seen across the table toward the framed family photos; three empty chairs; nobody in the room; no birthday decorations in view.
